objects.description:
Summer arrives with
long days and warm
sunlight that wraps
around every corner.
The air is light and sweet,
filled with the sound of
wind and quiet joy.
There’s no rush in summer,
just simple happiness
under the sun.
Let us wander freely,
breathe in the warm air,
and cherish every
bright and peaceful
moment this wonderful
season brings.
